== Summary ==
Portrait of [[Bill Martinson]], 520 × 642 px, cropped from the 720 × 642 px designer photo to center the head. The source page names his Decipher work, quoted under Source. The photo was posted on 27 January 2014 by the BoardGameGeek account "Bill Martinson" with the caption "In one of my favorite places, Silver Falls Park."

== Source ==
* [https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgamedesigner/3214/bill-martinson Bill Martinson], BoardGameGeek designer page, read 27 October 2026 (main image; Description: "Bill worked for Decipher for ten years, performing technical editing, design, development, and other duties for the Star Trek, Star Wars, and Lord of the Rings CCGs"). Image page: [https://boardgamegeek.com/image/1909357/bill-martinson image 1909357]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027203905/https://swccg.com/snapshots/bgg/bill-martinson-3214.html Internet Archive] (designer page with the photo and description), 27 October 2026.

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' head-and-shoulders portrait of Bill Martinson outdoors.
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Bill Martinson]].
* '''Portion used:''' a crop of the image as BoardGameGeek publishes it.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of the subject is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use of the photograph.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Bill Martinson. Used under fair use for identification only.
